title: Premium sky-blue homepage composition aligned to the selected design concept
scope: Actual homepage template composition redesign: hero hierarchy, four compact quick actions, separated operational workbench for movement registration and all-governorates employee search, preserving the existing forms, permissions, links, and single work-governorate selector in the topbar.

python.parser: python -m compileall for application, tests, contracts and scripts, plus root-level utilities

visual_review.source: Actual modified home.html/base.html rendered via Jinja with synthetic Admin context; local CSS assets inlined for Chromium screenshots; page scripts removed for deterministic visual review.

full_pytest_suite.reason: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named flask at tests/conftest.py before test collection; contract_tests ran separately and passed.

stylesheet_policy.canonical_tokens: Only in employee_movements/static/css/app.css; design-system-cyan.css contains component-specific rules.
stylesheet_policy.shared_design_system: Loaded globally after legacy and route-specific CSS.
stylesheet_policy.admin_reports_stylesheet: Loaded only on relevant administration/report/manager/audit routes.
stylesheet_policy.css_shadowing_audit: scripts/audit_css_shadowing.py, scripts/cleanup_shadowed_declarations_v68_44_5.py, and scripts/cleanup_cross_stylesheet_shadow_v68_44_6.py; all safe exact-selector/context candidates return zero after cleanup.
stylesheet_policy.homepage_stylesheet: css/pages/home-journey.css; loaded only when request.path == '/', after design-system-cyan.css

limitations: The new homepage composition is based on the existing Jinja template and retains the existing registration/search forms, route destinations, role gates and single topbar work-governorate selector.

Local Chromium previews were rendered from the modified Jinja templates using a synthetic Admin context and mock data; JavaScript was omitted for deterministic screenshots. No live Flask session or production database was used.
All 46 Jinja templates, 10 CSS files, JavaScript syntax, and Python compilation checks passed. The 348 contract tests, 13 workflow source-contract checks, and 59 POST-route security review passed.
The full Flask test suite could not start because Flask is not installed in the review environment. No deployment to GitHub or Blitz was performed.
